blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Students formed a long queue outside Mandurriao National High School along Q. Abeto Street here on Monday, Sept. 21, as heightened security measures were implemented following the deadly school shooting in South Cotabato last week. Security guards inspected students’ bags one by one as they entered the campus, while police personnel and patrol vehicles were stationed outside the school to help maintain order.
